question: How can I check my order status?
answer: You can check your order status by providing your order number. We will show you the latest available status and estimated delivery date.

question: Where can I find my order number?
answer: Your order number can be found in your order confirmation email or receipt. It usually starts with ORD-.

question: What do the different order statuses mean?
answer: Processing means your order is being prepared. Shipped means it has been dispatched. Delivered means it has reached the delivery destination. Delayed means delivery is taking longer than expected.

question: When will my order arrive?
answer: Your estimated delivery date is provided when you check your order status. Delivery times may vary depending on your location and the delivery provider.

question: How do I return an item?
answer: To start a return, provide your order number. We will check whether the order is eligible and then provide the next steps.

question: How long do I have to return an item?
answer: Eligible items can be returned within the applicable return window. Please provide your order number so we can check the eligibility of your specific order.

question: What happens after I request a return?
answer: Once your return is approved, you will receive instructions on how to return the item. Further processing depends on the condition of the returned item and the applicable return policy.

question: How can I check my refund status?
answer: Provide your order number and we can check whether your refund is pending, processing, or completed.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: Refund processing time can vary depending on the payment method and financial institution. You can provide your order number to check the current refund status.

question: Can I speak to a human support agent?
answer: Yes. If the chatbot cannot resolve your request or you prefer human assistance, you can request escalation to a support agent.

question: What can the chatbot help me with?
answer: The chatbot can currently help with order status, returns, refunds, and common customer support questions.

question: What if the chatbot cannot answer my question?
answer: If your question cannot be resolved automatically, you can request human support and your conversation can be escalated.
